capabilities: open files in new tabs from links, quick switcher, and file explorer
switch to an existing tab instead of duplicating a file
customize new tab placement and order, including the opposite split pane
preview files in a temporary italic tab and promote it on double-click or edit
toggle the main settings via commands
extras: Works by patching Obsidian's internal methods, which the README notes may cause plugin incompatibilities; a known interaction with PDF++ is documented with a workaround.
intentEvidence: It is inspired by the Opener plugin which worked in a similar way, but is no longer maintained
problem: Obsidian opens files in the current tab by default, so navigation from links or the file explorer can overwrite existing tabs and lose your place.

relations.evidence: It is inspired by the Opener plugin which worked in a similar way
You can make the plugins play nicely together by setting the "How to open..." options

summary: Tab behavior plugin that opens files in new tabs, deduplicates already-open files, and adds VSCode-style preview tabs.
